title: Resource-Aware Computation Engine — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Changes algorithms or model choices to fit available memory, processing power, and energy. A proposed engine that adapts computation to the resources at hand: when memory is tight it picks streaming algorithms; when the battery is low it picks cheaper models; when a GPU appears it switches to the fast path. The engine guarantees the chosen variant still meets the correctness contract.
capabilities: Monitor available memory, compute, and energy
Select algorithm variants that fit the budget
Switch model sizes to match energy constraints
Guarantee the correctness contract regardless of variant
Explain why each variant was chosen
